sentences.text: For floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals and sanctioned on or after 2026-01-01, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and that rule applies here because the case facts are floating, individual, non-business, and sanctioned in 2026.
The home-loan agreement says that on foreclosure or pre-payment, in full or in part, the borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding.
That agreement term conflicts with the in-force RBI rule for this case because one source allows no pre-payment charge and the other source requires a 3% charge.
I cannot determine whether clause 7.4 of the Retail Loan Policy complies because clause 7.4 itself was not provided in the evidence searched.

missing.searched: Reviewed the provided Retail Loan Policy excerpt and the other evidence, but no clause 7.4 wording was included.
